en.headline: MTR orders halt to unauthorised column repairs at Tung Chung West station
en.dek: Routine October inspections found unapproved filling works on platform-level columns; the operator says the issue does not affect structural safety and has ordered a full review.
body: The MTR Corporation has instructed its main contractor to stop unauthorised remedial works on columns at the under-construction Tung Chung West station after routine inspections last month uncovered incomplete works.

A spokesman said the inspections of unfinished works in October found that remedial works involving the filling of patching materials had been carried out at the heads of columns at the platform level without the MTR’s prior approval. The corporation immediately ordered the Bouygues-Dragages Joint Venture to suspend the works and to submit a full report and rectification plan before any resumption.

Media reports have described gaps of about 20 to 30 centimetres between some concrete columns and the ceiling on the concourse level, with roughly half of about 60 columns affected. The MTR said it is reviewing completed columns and construction methods on both the platform and concourse levels. It stressed that the situation does not involve structural safety and that related costs will be borne by the contractor. Relevant government departments have been notified.
Tung Chung West station forms part of the Tung Chung Line Extension. The main station structure is targeted for completion in the first half of 2027, with passenger service planned for 2029.

zh.headline: 港鐵東涌西站支柱未批修補工序叫停 強調不涉結構安全
zh.dek: 十月恒常巡查發現月台層部分支柱頂部有未經批准的物料填補工序，港鐵已指示總承建商停工並提交報告。
body: 港鐵公司表示，上月對東涌西站工地尚未完成的工序進行恆常巡查時，發現月台層部分支柱頂部末端曾進行物料填補的修補工序，有關工序並未事先獲得港鐵批准。
港鐵隨即指示總承建商布依格-寶嘉聯營即時停止有關工序，並展開深入調查，檢視車站月台層以至大堂層不同區域的已完工支柱及相關施工流程。港鐵強調有關情況並不涉及結構安全。
傳媒報道指大堂層約60條支柱中近半數石屎疑未灌到頂，與天花板之間有約20至30厘米空隙。港鐵稱總承建商須提交全面報告及修正方案，獲批准後才可復工，相關費用由承建商承擔，並已通知相關政府部門。
東涌西站屬東涌綫延綫一部分，主體結構預計2027年上半年完工，目標2029年通車。
